input_policy: Saved chosen media facts plus an opened QNC MediaStream. No discovery fallback, no original/proxy decision. One explicit native stream per instance.
output_policy: Bounded native video or PCM f32le packets with real integer PTS and rational timebase. No presentation acknowledgement, application workflow or clock.
buffer_policy: Decoder output queue is bounded to at most 8 packets and 512 MiB per decoder instance. This is transport smoothing, not a media cache or probe fallback.
adapter_policy: Injected DecoderAdapter or independently installed qnc-packets-v1 process. No FFmpeg command construction or technology selection in this module.
